Later FHIR-26666 added the nearby contained-resource fragment exception below the ValueSet example, and FHIR-12902 provides background for the canonical-reference datatype model; neither later context reverses the FHIR-19593 clarification.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/references.html already says canonical references use the canonical datatype to refer to the uri-typed url element, preserves the ValueSet example, and includes the later contained-resource exception needed to prevent overreading the statement.
